source: Saved Ghidra constructor registrations; render meanings in docs/drs/material-flags-engine.md

flags.name: UseVertexColor
flags.meaning: Multiplies the sampled texture RGBA by COLOR0 before the action-button color/effect processing.
flags.requirements: COLOR0 and color texture

flags.name: UseVertexColorDiffuse
flags.meaning: Registered engine control; its buffer field has no established consumer in the inspected SM4 Billboard draw/setup paths. Do not infer a visual effect from the corresponding StatefulParticles flag.

flags.name: SkipZTest
flags.meaning: Disables depth testing through the depth-state lookup.
flags.requirements: Ordinary/soft path; distortion mode uses a fixed depth state.

flags.name: SkipZWrite
flags.meaning: Disables depth writes through the depth-state lookup.
flags.requirements: Ordinary/soft path; distortion mode uses a fixed depth state.

flags.name: UseFog
flags.meaning: Registered engine control; its buffer field has no established consumer in the inspected SM4 Billboard draw/setup paths. Do not infer a visual effect from the corresponding StatefulParticles flag.

flags.name: UseVertexColorEmissive
flags.meaning: Registered engine control; its buffer field has no established consumer in the inspected SM4 Billboard draw/setup paths. Do not infer a visual effect from the corresponding StatefulParticles flag.

flags.name: UseLodBias
flags.meaning: Enables PS sample_b using TEXCOORD4.x provided by the billboard VS.
flags.requirements: Billboard vertex bias input; see selected VS for exact packing.

flags.name: UseAlphaMask
flags.meaning: Samples separate MaskTexture and multiplies its alpha into the ordinary textured output alpha. RGB is not multiplied by this mask in the inspected variant.
flags.requirements: MaskTexture plus appropriate generated mask UVs.

flags.name: SnapIn
flags.meaning: Selects a specialized cliff vertex layout. Decodes COLOR0 into instance/segment indices and uses InstanceData, SegmentHeight and TEXCOORD5 to reconstruct/deform world position and basis; this is terrain-segment fitting, not a generic origin toggle.
flags.requirements: Renderer cliff instance data, segment heights and specially packed vertex attributes.

flags.name: WriteAlpha
flags.meaning: Selects one of two blend-state objects. Their write masks are 0x907 (RGB) and 0x90f (RGBA), so true also permits alpha output writes.

flags.name: EnableAlphaTest
flags.meaning: Selects the alpha-test pixel-shader variant. Inspected Debug/DiffuseSpecular/Lava shader pairs add a discard against AlphaTestRef; input alpha calculation depends on the material.
flags.requirements: Meaningful output alpha and an AlphaTestRef setup value; not an alpha-blend enable flag.

flags.name: EnableAlphaTest
flags.meaning: Selects alpha-test shader variants and affects Default render-category selection.

flags.name: UseParameterMap
flags.meaning: Selects parameter-map variants: RGBA replaces scalar smoothness, metalness, reflectivity and emissivity in the inspected Default SM4 pixel shaders.
flags.requirements: Parameter texture with meaningful RGBA channels.

flags.name: UseNormalMap
flags.meaning: Selects normal-map variants.
flags.requirements: Normal texture and suitable tangent basis.

flags.name: UseEnvironmentMap
flags.meaning: Selects environment/reflection variants; renderer fallback source exists.

flags.name: DisableReceiveShadows
flags.meaning: Registered field and engine name confirmed. A render consumer/effect has not been established; the previous negative runtime read-watch experiment had unreliable controls and cannot prove global inactivity.

flags.name: EnableSHLighting
flags.meaning: Registered field and engine name confirmed. A render consumer/effect has not been established; the previous negative runtime read-watch experiment had unreliable controls and cannot prove global inactivity.

flags.name: DecalMode
flags.meaning: Selects the decal render category/state path; traced Default path suppresses depth writes.

flags.name: EnableAlphaTest
flags.meaning: Selects the alpha-test pixel-shader variant. Inspected Debug/DiffuseSpecular/Lava shader pairs add a discard against AlphaTestRef; input alpha calculation depends on the material.
flags.requirements: Meaningful output alpha and an AlphaTestRef setup value; not an alpha-blend enable flag.

flags.requirements: Meaningful output alpha and an AlphaTestRef setup value; not an alpha-blend enable flag.

flags.requirements: Meaningful output alpha and an AlphaTestRef setup value; not an alpha-blend enable flag.

flags.name: UseLodBias
flags.meaning: Selects the VS variant that writes scalar LodBias into TEXCOORD4.x for a downstream particle pixel shader.
flags.requirements: Matching downstream pixel shader that consumes the bias.

flags.name: DynamicFlow
flags.meaning: Selects a distinct PS permutation and enables three flow/noise texture bindings (falling back to GetLavaNoiseTexture), coordinate transforms and once-per-frame flow-state updates.
flags.requirements: Fluid texture/flow parameters and renderer time.

flags.name: Glow
flags.meaning: Switches both blend-state and depth-state objects. It is a render-mode toggle; a direct emissivity or bloom-output formula has not been established.

flags.name: EnableAlphaTest
flags.meaning: Selects the alpha-test pixel-shader variant. Inspected Debug/DiffuseSpecular/Lava shader pairs add a discard against AlphaTestRef; input alpha calculation depends on the material.
flags.requirements: Meaningful output alpha and an AlphaTestRef setup value; not an alpha-blend enable flag.

flags.name: MouseLight
flags.meaning: Applies cursor-centered lighting: distance falloff combines LightColor with AmbientColor; cursor position is supplied by input controls.
flags.requirements: Input controls and LightDistance/LightColor/AmbientColor.

flags.name: UseTextureAlpha
flags.meaning: Uses sampled texture alpha multiplied by squared COLOR0 alpha in the inspected variant; disabled variant uses COLOR0 alpha and ignores texture alpha.
flags.requirements: Color texture with meaningful alpha.

flags.name: ShowFow
flags.meaning: Samples FowSampler with vertically flipped UV, blends its red/green channels using FowBlend, and modulates output color.
flags.requirements: Renderer FOW texture; active color-texture permutation.

flags.name: SkipZTest
flags.meaning: Selects depth-test bypass states; inspected ordinary path uses the flag for both the test and write-state selectors.

flags.name: WireFrame
flags.meaning: Selects an alternate rasterizer-state group, including wireframe fill (0xb02) in the constructor rather than solid fill (0xb01).

flags.name: AlphaOnlyTexture
flags.meaning: Uses the texture alpha while replacing sampled RGB with white, then multiplies by the particle color; texture RGB is ignored.
flags.requirements: Texture alpha and particle color.

flags.name: UseLodBias
flags.meaning: Selects PS sample_b with interpolated TEXCOORD4.x instead of ordinary sample.
flags.requirements: Matching vertex stream supplying TEXCOORD4.x.

flags.name: UseLodBias
flags.meaning: Selects the VS variant that writes scalar LodBias into TEXCOORD4.x for a downstream particle pixel shader.
flags.requirements: Matching downstream pixel shader that consumes the bias.

flags.name: UseVertexColor
flags.meaning: Selects the vertex-color vertex shader instead of material Color.
flags.requirements: Vertex COLOR0

flags.name: DisableDepthWrite
flags.meaning: Disables depth writes through the combined depth-state lookup.

flags.name: DisableDepthTest
flags.meaning: Disables the depth test through the combined depth-state lookup.

flags.name: UseFog
flags.meaning: Enables the VS distance-fog calculation using ViewWorldPos, FogParams, FogStartColor and FogEndColor.
flags.requirements: Renderer fog constants

flags.name: UseFOW
flags.meaning: Selects the fog-of-war variant when the renderer fog-of-war input is enabled; otherwise setup forces the selector to zero.
flags.requirements: Active renderer fog-of-war data

flags.name: SkipZTest
flags.meaning: Participates in the depth-state selector and disables depth testing; the other selector input depends on fade/setup state.

flags.name: UseVertexColorDiffuse
flags.meaning: Uses COLOR0 (BGRA swizzled to RGBA) instead of the material Color constant for the diffuse-color input; requires vertex color data.
flags.requirements: COLOR0

flags.name: SkipZTest
flags.meaning: Disables the depth test through the depth-state lookup; SkipZWrite independently controls depth writes in the ordinary/soft path.
flags.requirements: BillboardMode 2 distortion path binds a fixed depth state and bypasses these toggles.

flags.name: SkipZWrite
flags.meaning: Disables depth writes through the depth-state lookup.
flags.requirements: Ordinary/soft path; BillboardMode 2 uses a fixed state.

flags.name: UseFog
flags.meaning: Engine label suggests fog participation, but the registered field has no established consumer in the inspected SM4 draw/setup paths; those paths already compute fog independently.

flags.name: UseVertexColorEmissive
flags.meaning: Adds COLOR1 to the selected color input (including alpha), before the later particle color/texture operations.
flags.requirements: COLOR1

flags.name: UseLodBias
flags.meaning: Enables explicit texture mip bias: VS forwards 3 * BLENDWEIGHT0.w; PS uses sample_b with that interpolated bias.
flags.requirements: Particle vertex BLENDWEIGHT0.w. This is a shader bias, separate from the DRS texture-load bias.

flags.name: EnableAlphaTest
flags.meaning: Registered at buffer offset 0x3c. No read of that slot was established in the inspected SM4 normal/cobweb draw paths; do not borrow the proven Default or DiffuseSpecular behavior.

flags.name: EnableCobwebMode
flags.meaning: Routes drawing through the separate cobweb render implementation (different shader/setup tables and fixed blend/depth state). Exact final cobweb surface formula remains undecoded.

flags.name: IndicateLayerComplexity
flags.meaning: Enables diagnostic RGB tint: lerp(shadedRGB, DebugColor.rgb, DebugColor.a) in the inspected nonzero-layer PS pair. It does not change mesh LOD.
flags.requirements: Lit/high-quality terrain path and DebugColor.

flags.name: IndicateLayerComplexity
flags.meaning: Registered terrain diagnostic label. No consumer of offset 0x70 was established in the inspected SM4 draw, auxiliary-pass and setup functions.

flags.name: FullyOpaque
flags.meaning: Registered opacity label at offset 0xa0, sharing bit 16 with IndicateLayerComplexity. Generic DRS transfer reaches only the first matching slot; no independent DRS switch or rendering consumer established.
flags.requirements: Can only be independently addressed by another API/slot path, if used. Bit 16 alone does not set this slot.

flags.name: IndicateLayerComplexity
flags.meaning: Enables diagnostic RGB tint: lerp(shadedRGB, DebugColor.rgb, DebugColor.a) in the inspected nonzero-layer PS pair. It does not change mesh LOD.
flags.requirements: Lit/high-quality terrain path and DebugColor.

flags.name: IndicateLayerComplexity
flags.meaning: Registered terrain diagnostic label. No consumer of offset 0x70 was established in the inspected SM4 draw, auxiliary-pass and setup functions.

flags.name: FullyOpaque

flags.requirements: Can only be independently addressed by another API/slot path, if used. Bit 16 alone does not set this slot.

flags.name: UseVertexColor
flags.meaning: Selects vertex-color VS variants in ordinary textured paths.
flags.requirements: Vertex COLOR0; DisplayMode-specific.

flags.name: DisableDepthWrite
flags.meaning: Disables depth writes through the combined depth-state lookup.
flags.requirements: DisplayMode-specific; diagnostic modes bind fixed states.

flags.name: DisableDepthTest
flags.meaning: Disables depth testing through the combined depth-state lookup.
flags.requirements: DisplayMode-specific; diagnostic modes bind fixed states.

flags.name: UseFog
flags.meaning: Registered at offset 0x78, but no consumer of that field established in the inspected SM4 draw/setup paths. UseVertexFog is a separate, traced toggle.

flags.name: UseVertexFog
flags.meaning: Selects distinct VS and PS variants through offset 0x88 in ordinary textured/fogged paths.
flags.requirements: Renderer fog data; DisplayMode-specific.

flags.name: UseVertexColorDiffuse
flags.meaning: Uses COLOR0 (BGRA swizzled to RGBA) instead of the material Color constant for the diffuse-color input; requires vertex color data.
flags.requirements: COLOR0

flags.requirements: BillboardMode 2 distortion path binds a fixed depth state and bypasses these toggles.

flags.requirements: Particle vertex BLENDWEIGHT0.w. This is a shader bias, separate from the DRS texture-load bias.

flags.name: MouseLight
flags.meaning: Applies cursor-centered lighting: distance falloff combines LightColor with AmbientColor; cursor position is supplied by input controls.
flags.requirements: Input controls and LightDistance/LightColor/AmbientColor.

flags.name: UseTextureAlpha
flags.meaning: Uses sampled texture alpha multiplied by squared COLOR0 alpha in the inspected variant; disabled variant uses COLOR0 alpha and ignores texture alpha.
flags.requirements: Color texture with meaningful alpha.

flags.name: ColorDisable
flags.meaning: Blends colored RGB toward luminance (0.30 R + 0.59 G + 0.11 B), with COLOR1.alpha controlling the desaturation amount; primary opacity is preserved in the inspected pair.
flags.requirements: Second vertex color channel COLOR1; 0 keeps color, 1 gives grayscale.

flags.name: DisableDepthTest
flags.meaning: Uses the flag for both test/write selectors, bypassing depth testing and selecting the matching write state.

flags.name: LastPixel
flags.meaning: Selects rasterizer states with description byte 0x1c set. DX9 copies this to its state and applies render-state 0x10 (LastPixel); DX10/DX11 explicitly return null for these descriptions. It is not a supported DX10/DX11 mesh-appearance feature.
flags.requirements: Legacy DX9 line rasterization; avoid enabling on DX10/DX11.
